headline: Turkey's BIST 100 Index Closes 1.3% Higher
summary: Turkey's BIST 100 index gained approximately 150 points, closing 1.3% higher.
why: The BIST 100 is the benchmark stock market index for Borsa Istanbul, tracking the performance of the 100 largest companies traded on the exchange.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: The index rose 1.3% at the close of trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Borsa Istanbul equities advanced, pushing the main index up by 1.3% at the close.
